0.name: The Fool
0.upright: A fresh start is asking for your yes. Pack light, stay curious, and take the first step even if the path ahead is still foggy.
0.reversed: Pause before you leap. You may be holding back from a start you are ready for, or rushing into one you have not thought through.
0.love: New romance or a playful reset — stay open, not naive.
0.career: A new role or venture favors the bold beginner.
0.money: Small brave bets beat big blind ones.
0.health: Move your body; watch for careless knocks.

1.name: The Magician
1.upright: You already have every tool this needs. Pick one goal, focus your skill on it, and act — this is a week for doing, not doubting.
1.reversed: Your talent is leaking into too many directions, or someone is selling confidence they do not have. Narrow down and verify.
1.love: Charm is high — use it honestly, not to impress.
1.career: A skill you underrate is exactly what the task needs.
1.money: Negotiate; you have more leverage than you think.
1.health: Channel restless energy into one healthy routine.

2.name: The High Priestess
2.upright: The answer is already in you. Get quiet, notice what you keep circling back to, and trust the pull before you can explain it.
2.reversed: You are overriding your own knowing — with other people's opinions, or with busyness. Secrets (kept or kept from you) need daylight.
2.love: Pay attention to what is unsaid between you.
2.career: Wait one beat before committing; information is still surfacing.
2.money: Read the fine print; something is unstated.
2.health: Your body is signaling — sleep, rest, listen.

3.name: The Empress
3.upright: Tend what you want to grow — a project, a relationship, yourself. Comfort, beauty, and patience compound into abundance.
3.reversed: You are pouring out with nothing coming back in, or gripping too tightly. Refill your own cup first; loosen the grip.
3.love: Warmth and care deepen the bond; let yourself receive too.
3.career: Mentor, create, make things beautiful — it pays.
3.money: Steady nurturing grows savings; avoid comfort overspending.
3.health: Rest, good food, nature — indulge the senses kindly.

4.name: The Emperor
4.upright: Build the frame and the picture will hold. Set clear rules, budgets, and boundaries — order now buys freedom later.
4.reversed: Too rigid or too loose: either control is choking the life out, or nothing is holding. Adjust the structure, not the goal.
4.love: Commitment needs clear agreements, not assumptions.
4.career: Process, hierarchy, and follow-through win the day.
4.money: Budget like an emperor: every baht has a post.

5.name: The Hierophant
5.upright: Tried paths and wise guides have something for you. Learn the tradition first — then decide what to keep and what to reshape.
5.reversed: Rules for rules' sake are in the way. Question the doctrine, the guru, the 'we have always done it this way'.
5.love: Shared values and rituals hold you together.
5.career: A mentor, course, or institution opens the next door.
5.money: Conventional advice fits now; skip exotic schemes.
5.health: Trust established care; get a second opinion if uneasy.

6.name: The Lovers
6.upright: A union — of people or of values — is the heart of this. Choose what you truly align with, and let the choice be wholehearted.
6.reversed: Something is off-key: values clashing, a third pull, or a decision postponed. Name the misalignment before it names you.
6.love: Deep bond, real choice. Choose each other daily.
6.career: Partnership and shared vision beat solo grinding.
6.money: Align spending with what you actually value.
6.health: Balance caring for others with caring for yourself.

7.name: The Chariot
7.upright: Grip the reins and move. Opposing pulls resolve when you commit to one direction — victory comes through focused will.
7.reversed: You are revving with no steering, or pushing a wall. Re-aim, drop a competing goal, then drive again.
7.love: Steer the relationship somewhere on purpose; drift kills it.
7.career: Ambitious push now — keep every horse facing one way.
7.money: Drive toward one money goal; stop splitting fuel.
7.health: Directed effort (training plan, sleep hours) works.

8.name: Strength
8.upright: Real strength is gentle: patience with yourself, courage without noise. Tame the lion with calm persistence, not the whip.
8.reversed: You are muscling through on fumes, or doubting a strength you actually have. Soften the grip; rest is part of power.
8.love: Patience and softness tame tensions; no ultimatums.
8.health: Gentle consistency heals more than heroic bursts.

9.name: The Hermit
9.upright: Step back and go inward for a while. Fewer voices, one lantern: your own experience will show the next step.
9.reversed: Solitude has curdled into isolation, or you are dodging the quiet work. Reconnect — with one person, or with yourself.
9.love: A little space clarifies; too much starves. Say what you need.
9.career: Deep work beats meetings this week; document as you go.
9.money: Review alone before any joint decision.
9.health: Restorative solitude: sleep, walks, less screen.

10.name: Wheel of Fortune
10.upright: The wheel is turning in your favor. Ride the upswing: say yes to the opening, and remember luck favors the ready.
10.reversed: Timing is off or change feels forced. Do not fight the cycle — stabilize what you can and wait for the turn.
10.love: A turning point: ride it together, not against each other.
10.career: Fortune shifts — position yourself where it lands.
10.money: Upswing favors action; downswing favors saving.
10.health: Cycles pass; support the body through the low part.

11.name: Justice
11.upright: Weigh it honestly and call it fairly. Truth, contracts, and consequences are in focus — act so your side stays clean.
11.reversed: Something is tilted: bias (yours or theirs), blame-shifting, or a bill coming due. Rebalance before it compounds.
11.career: Contracts, reviews, credit where due — document everything.
11.money: Debts, taxes, fairness in splits: settle cleanly.
11.health: Honest accounting of habits; adjust without shame.

12.name: The Hanged Man
12.upright: Hang loose on purpose. Flip the viewpoint — the answer looks different upside down — and let timing do its half.
12.reversed: The pause has expired into a stall, or you are suffering for show. Either move or admit you are choosing to wait.
12.love: Stop pushing; see it from their angle for a week.
12.career: Delay is data. Use the waiting productively.
12.money: Hold position; no heroics in fog.
12.health: Rest is the treatment; stop negotiating with it.

13.name: Death
13.upright: Something is over so something can begin. Grieve it, thank it, lay it down — the transformation needs the empty hands.
13.reversed: You are dragging what already ended. The longer the grip, the heavier the cost; release is overdue, not optional.
13.love: An old pattern must die for love to live.
13.career: End the dead project; free the energy.
13.money: Cut the losing line; mourn the sunk cost once.
13.health: Release one habit that belongs to an older you.

14.name: Temperance
14.upright: Mix, don't swing. Small steady blends — work and rest, give and take — turn ordinary days into quiet gold.
14.reversed: Too much of something (or someone) has tipped the scales. Cut back to the middle path; extremes are billing you.
14.love: Blend, don't merge. Keep your own flavor.
14.career: Sustainable pace; mix deep work with recovery.
14.money: Middle path: save some, enjoy some.

15.name: The Devil
15.upright: Look honestly at the chain: the habit, the story, the comfort you chose. Naming it loosens it — shame tightens it.
15.reversed: The chains are loosening. Keep walking out: one honest day at a time, and do not romanticize the cage.
15.love: Obsession or control dressed as passion — call it out.
15.career: Golden handcuffs? Price your freedom honestly.
15.money: Spending loops and shiny traps — freeze one card.
15.health: Face the coping habit; replace, don't just remove.

16.name: The Tower
16.upright: What was shaky is falling — let it. Towers fall so truer ones rise; save what matters, release the rest to the lightning.
16.reversed: You are holding up what already cracked, or rebuilding quietly after the bang. Either way: smaller, truer, on rock this time.
16.love: A shock clears the air — rebuild honest or release.
16.career: Structures change; be the one who adapts first.
16.money: Expect the jolt; keep a buffer for falling bricks.
16.health: Sudden signals need attention now, not later.

17.name: The Star
17.upright: After the storm, stars. Hope is realistic now: heal gently, wish concretely, and let small steady lights guide you.
17.reversed: Hope feels far, but it is dimmed, not dead. Tend one small light — a routine, a person, a page — until it steadies.
17.career: Share your vision; hope attracts help.
17.money: Calm recovery; wish with a plan attached.
17.health: Healing is underway; support it gently.

18.name: The Moon
18.upright: Things glimmer but do not resolve yet. Trust dreams and hunches, double-check facts, and do not sign in moonlight.
18.reversed: Fog is lifting: fears named shrink, confusion untangles. Keep going — daylight is a decision away.
18.love: Illusions dissolve; see the person, not the projection.
18.career: Verify before you commit; rumors are loud now.
18.health: Sleep and dreams carry messages; rest more.

19.name: The Sun
19.upright: Yes — bright, simple yes. Joy, clarity, and energy are yours: celebrate openly and share the warmth around.
19.reversed: Clouds, not night: joy delayed or dimmed, success still coming. Do not fake the smile — tend the small good things.
19.love: Warm, honest, playful — let it show.
19.career: Visibility and wins; take the bow.
19.money: Sunny outlook; still budget the picnic.

20.name: Judgement
20.upright: A calling is sounding — rise to the bigger version of you. Forgive the old chapters; answer with changed action.
20.reversed: The inner judge is too loud, or you keep missing the call. Turn criticism into instruction; tie up one old thread.
20.love: Forgive and choose fresh — or admit it is over.
20.career: Your calling is knocking; answer with a move.
20.money: Review past money lessons; apply one now.
20.health: Forgive the body; start the new regimen kindly.

21.name: The World
21.upright: The circle closes beautifully. Complete it, celebrate it, carry the lesson — a bigger circle is already forming.
21.reversed: Nearly there: one loose end keeps the circle open. Tie it, and the completion (and the celebration) unlocks.
21.love: Wholeness together — or whole on your own. Both count.
21.career: Finish strong; the credential is the completion.
21.money: A cycle completes; harvest, then plan the next.
21.health: Integration: body, mind, and rhythm aligned.

22.name: Ace of Wands
22.upright: A new seed in this suit's domain — raw, bright potential. Fire moves it: energy, courage, and momentum.
22.reversed: The seed cannot sprout yet: wrong soil, wrong season, or a gift refused. Fire unchecked: haste, burnout, or pride running the show.
22.love: Passion and playfulness — keep it kind, not competitive.
22.career: Ambition and initiative open doors; finish what you start.
22.money: Bold moves need budgets; fund the spark, not the blaze.
22.health: Move, sweat, discharge — then rest deliberately.
